'''Calle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], she was stationed at the [[Business Sector Tram Station]] in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], distributing [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and medical supplies to other Imperial forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Calle appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Stims Vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
